summary: The test audit graded all 16 acceptance criteria of Kiln Audit Loop Limits at commit 1bd85fb. Four are Adequate (AC-LOOP-01, AC-TEST-01, AC-SHOW-01, AC-EFFORT-01), and a deliberate break of each was caught by its tests. The other twelve are Weak, none Missing, and none is unbuilt: each has a stated part no test would notice breaking, including three high-risk criteria (AC-DELIV-01, AC-TEST-02, AC-STOP-02). The gaps and their fixes are saved in test-audit.md for fixing sessions, high-risk rows first.
